bearing.config.v1alpha1.AuthorityOverrid.description:
AuthorityOverride sets the authority of exactly one field, link or
 derived source. In ProtoJSON it reads as the data model's examples:
 { "kind": ..., "predicate": ..., "authority": ... }.

derived.description: A derivation rule: the authority of core/derive/<rule>/<this source>.

direction.description: A field target only: DIRECTION_IN for relations given with "from".
direction.title: Direction

kind.description: The kind of a field or link target; empty for a derived target.

predicate.description: A declared field: with kind and direction.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.AuthorityOverrid.title: Authority Override

bearing.config.v1alpha1.CapabilityGrant..description:
CapabilityGrant is one capability an adapter may call, with its scope
 (ADR 9), for example http limited to hosts.

name.description:
The capability: http, log, trace, metrics, config, kv or clock. The list
 is ADR 9's and grows with Bearing, so it is not an enum; a name the core
 does not know is rejected.

scope.description: What it may reach: hosts for http, empty for the rest.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.CapabilityGrant..title: Capability Grant

bearing.config.v1alpha1.LinkRef.schema.j.description: LinkRef names a declared link by the other system's key type.

^(keyType)$.description: A key type declared for that issuer type.

key_type.description: A key type declared for that issuer type.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.LinkRef.schema.j.title: Link Ref

bearing.config.v1alpha1.NamespaceUse.sch.description:
NamespaceUse is a namespace a source issues or links, with its issuer type
 (docs/spec/data-model.md, "Keys and namespaces").

^(issuerType)$.description: The kind of issuer, for example "saml".

^(keyClasses)$.description: Issued namespaces only: overrides of a key type's class, by key type.

issuer_type.description: The kind of issuer, for example "saml".

key_classes.description: Issued namespaces only: overrides of a key type's class, by key type.

bearing.config.v1alpha1.NamespaceUse.sch.title: Namespace Use

adapter.description: The Adapter it runs, by name. Required.

authority.description: Overrides of declared authority, one per target.

capabilities.description: Narrows the adapter's capabilities; never widens them.

issues.description: Other namespaces it is the issuer for.

namespace.description: The namespace it reads. Default: the adapter's issuer type.

schedule.description:
Time between scheduled syncs, an ISO 8601 duration such as "PT1H".
 Empty: webhooks and manual syncs only.

secrets.description:
Secret references by the adapter's secret name: "env:NAME",
 "file:/path", "vault:path#key", "aws-sm:arn". Never values.

settings.description: Its settings, checked against the adapter's declared settings.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Authority.schema..description:
Authority is a source's claim to be the source of record. It is a message
 so levels can be added later without breaking declarations or overrides.

authoritative.description: True when the source is the source of record. Default false.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.Authority.schema..title: Authority
